description:

description:
3D scan of the scale model (22 cm) of a West Indian manatee (*Trichechus manatus*). 

This resin model was created by [Naturaliter Srl](https://www.naturaliter.com/) for the exhibition Not Only Cetaceans. Complementing the exhibition dedicated to marine mammals, this display focuses on animals that have adapted to life in the water through evolutionary pathways different from those of dolphins and whales. The exhibition features sirenians (dugongs and manatees), pinnipeds (sea lions, seals, and walruses), and the polar bear. On display are complete skeletons and skulls from the Museum’s historical collections, as well as scale and life-size models and casts of both extant and extinct species. The scale models were specifically designed to be tactile, enabling visually impaired and blind people, to explore and understand the shapes of these animals and their fossil ancestors.

Specimen: West Indian manatee, *Trichechus manatus* Linnaeus, 1758
